reuse.why: The new action takes its categories from getMonthFillCategories, filters with isMonthFillCategory and signs the amount with toAverageFillAmount, exactly the helpers the existing month-wide actions use.

duplication.why: No selection, exclusion or sign logic is repeated; only the small per-action loop shape that every sibling action has.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Only the action, its registration and its tests.

maintainability.why: Any future change to which categories month-wide actions fill or how amounts are signed applies to the new action automatically.
